correctness.rationale: Proof derives a unique bilinear form from the intrinsic nonzero square vector, proves natural bases are exactly orthonormal frames, identifies the characteristic vector and support parity, and constructs all intermediate parity-preserving support sizes using explicit orthogonal weight-four transvections. Full support is possible iff u=c. All dimension-boundary cases are explicit. Independent exact finite checking tested all orthonormal frames up to n=5 and complete generated orbits up to n=9, with VERIFY_OK. Complete transitivity on the parity orbit yields the exact conditional binomial law by orbit-stabilizer, independently verified by exact finite frame counts.
